scripts.dev: npm run build:plugins && concurrently "npm run dev -w @fpp/api" "npm run dev -w @fpp/host"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fpp/shared && npm run build -w @fpp/event-bus && npm run build -w @fpp/plugin-sdk && npm run build:plugins && npm run build -w @fpp/api && npm run build -w @fpp/host
scripts.build:plugins: npm run build -w @fpp/plugin-i18n && npm run build -w @fpp/plugin-themes && npm run build -w @fpp/plugin-calculator && npm run build -w @fpp/plugin-task-manager && npm run build -w @fpp/plugin-notifications && npm run build -w @fpp/plugin-reports
